name: pyramid-task
description: Plan and assure brownfield software changes with evidence-backed task pyramids, durable pause/resume handoffs, safe intent transitions, inspections, audit gates, dossiers, and interactive overlays.

interface.shortDescription: Brownfield change assurance for agents and humans.
interface.longDescription: Turn an intent into a validated pathfinder graph, baseline an existing system, map change impact, enforce inspection-aware audit gates, pause and resume agent work through durable checked handoffs, migrate active V2 plans without rebuilding, safely transition completed clusters into a new intent, carry the verified baseline through the full lifecycle, and explore interactive task and assurance overlays.
defaultPrompt: Turn this feature into an evidence-backed task pyramid.
Assess this existing system and map the change impact before implementation.
Upgrade this running V2.1 plan to V3 without rebuilding it.
Start a new intent after this completed task cluster without losing its history.
Pause this claimed task with a durable handoff, then resume it safely later.
Show what is ready, active, blocked, and unaudited.
Propose and preview a safe expansion for this broad task.
